title: Workday Integration Methodology
description: CoP-standard approach for designing, building, testing, and deploying Workday integrations across all supported patterns (Studio, Core Connector, EIB, REST/SOAP, RaaS).
summary: Defines integration patterns, naming conventions, error handling standards, ISU security setup, and the 5-phase integration lifecycle (Design → Build → Test → Deploy → Monitor).

title: Finance Data Conversion Runbook
description: Standard playbook for migrating financial data into Workday — covering iLoad templates, data cleansing rules, reconciliation checkpoints, and cutover sequencing for General Ledger, Suppliers, Customers, and Fixed Assets.
summary: End-to-end guide for financial data migration: source-to-target mapping, iLoad sequence, reconciliation sign-off criteria, and post-cutover validation procedures.

title: CoP Operating Model & Charter
description: Defines how the Workday Finance Tech Sub-CoP operates: governance structure, meeting cadence, asset contribution process, knowledge-sharing expectations, and escalation paths.
summary: Governance charter covering CoP mission, membership obligations, monthly reporting cycle, asset review process, and how consultants contribute and consume CoP resources.

title: AI Use Case Evaluation Framework
description: Framework for assessing, prioritizing, and approving new AI use cases within the CoP practice — covering feasibility scoring, data readiness assessment, ROI estimation, risk evaluation, and stage-gate criteria.
summary: 5-stage evaluation gate (Identify → Assess → Pilot → Deploy → Scale) with scoring rubrics for technical feasibility, business value, data readiness, and compliance risk.
